title: APPROVAL OF 3-YEAR CONTRACT WITH LOOMIS, SAYLES &
text:
[VII. INVESTMENTS]
APPROVAL OF 3-YEAR CONTRACT WITH LOOMIS, SAYLES &
  COMPANY, L.P. REGARDING THE MANAGEMENT OF AN ACTIVE
  CORE FIXED INCOME PORTFOLIO AND POSSIBLE BOARD ACTION
summary: The board will consider approving a three-year contract with Loomis, Sayles & Company, L.P. to manage an active core fixed income portfolio.
